acceptanceCriteria: Eight approved synthesized timbres use stable shared identifiers and platform-neutral parameter definitions without sampled resources.
Each timbre retains the requested fundamental through attack and sustain, with deterministic tests for accuracy, sustain, clipping, aliasing, level comparison, and transitions.
Route and physical listening requirements are recorded without claiming simulator qualification as listening evidence.
notes: Depends on T-0002 implementation evidence; no catalog persistence, authoring UI, synchronization, or external services.
